spans.s: रौद्र (I) a. (f. द्रा or द्री) Violent, wrathful, savage, terrible.
रौद्र (II) m. 1. A worshipper of Rudra; 2. warmth, ardour, wrath; 3. winter; 4. one of the eight or nine sentiments in rhetoric, the sentiment of wrath or terribleness, S.
रौद्र (III) n. 1. Fierceness, savageness; 2. heat, warmth; 3. wrath.
